notes: NGA is the primary model authority; other registries and packages are secondary metadata sources.
EGM96 is legacy. NGA currently publishes EGM2008 and lists a 2.5-minute worldwide grid; NGA's WGS84 page tentatively anticipates a new EGM in 2028.
The GeographicLib published digest is recorded but has not been verified against a locally downloaded artifact.
